answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in gale and jade lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the zephyr graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 877 impostors cost 1613 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
